paired_contrast.interpretation: Joint descriptive effects; no composite winner or independent-acquisition inference

frozen_operating_point: rank 158869 of 160473 normal-calibration scores, strictly greater alarm

claims.correction_score_effect: O-RC F1 exceeds O-R by 0.000689011209901752 with 27 fewer normal alarm points and 10 fewer normal episodes; still less than 0.9% point recall.
claims.progression_effect: Not isolated by primary contrast; both contain progression. Similar outcomes for free/unconstrained, velocity-only residual and velocity control do not establish statistical equivalence or progression benefit.
claims.controls: AR has higher F1/AP and slightly fewer normal alarm points than O-RC, but more normal episodes. Fixed template has higher F1/recall with increased point false alarms and AP below mixed prevalence.
claims.events: All eight overlap/fresh hits for O-RC coexist with 554 normal episodes over about 2.98 hours and sparse within-event alarms. No pre-existing alarm at any of 88 event starts; overlap and fresh delay coincide in these data.
claims.delay: On the seven commonly detected events, O-RC is unchanged for five and later for two; lower detected-set median is not evidence of faster matched detection.
claims.scope: One repetitive acquisition with eight dependent scheduled intervals; no p-values, seed-generalization claim, physical twin validation or independent cyber-generalization evidence.
